faq.1.q: How do I find my bus at the station?
faq.1.a: Your ticket shows the platform number. Every platform at the bus station has a sign, so the right one is easy to find.
faq.2.q: How do tickets for children work?
faq.2.a: Conditions for children depend on the carrier: usually small children travel free without a separate seat, older children with a discount. Ask the call center for exact terms.
faq.3.q: Can I travel with a pet?
faq.3.a: Usually yes, but the animal travels in the luggage compartment and must not disturb other passengers or the driver. Agree it with the carrier in advance.
faq.4.q: I lost my luggage, what should I do?
faq.4.a: Contact the station dispatcher or the call center and give the trip and ticket number.
faq.5.q: I lost my ticket, can it be restored?
faq.5.a: Yes. In your profile choose "Restore tickets" and confirm the phone number the ticket was bought with.
faq.6.q: My plans changed, will I get a refund?
faq.6.a: You can return a ticket in "My tickets" up to {min} minutes before departure. The ticket price is refunded, the service fee ({fee}%) is not. If you miss the trip, the carrier's terms apply.
faq.7.q: Which documents do I need to buy a ticket?
faq.7.a: Trips inside Uzbekistan don't ask for passport details. International trips need the passport series, number and date of birth, and you must carry your passport.
